purpose: Third independent epoch-1 reproduction of the frozen fully supervised GT reference, requested after an external similar experiment reported a different result.
scientific_role: fully supervised reference stability audit only; never a WSL result

training_contract.augmentation: paired random horizontal flip p=0.5 on train only
training_contract.checkpoint_selection: maximum validation tumor-only Dice at threshold 0.5; tie-break by normal empty-mask specificity within Dice tolerance 0.0001

evaluation_contract.primary_population: all 184 validation tumor images including complete misses

audit_plan: verify frozen source, split, pretrained-weight and wrapper hashes
recompute checkpoint selection from the complete training log
recompute threshold selection and all per-image metrics
compare v3 against both the frozen reference and independent reproduction v2
quantify paired per-image and complete-group differences by lesion-size subgroup
report environment/version differences and test-access status
promotion_rule: The frozen reference is not replaced automatically. Any update requires a separate decision after the third-run stability audit.
